# Index of Major Examples

Use this index to revisit the cases, demonstrations, and worked examples most likely to appear in class discussion and application questions. **Evidence role** states what the example can do. A demonstration or illustration can reveal a possibility; it is not by itself evidence of prevalence, effect size, causality, or generality.

## Linked video cases

The book links to third-party videos rather than reproducing frames. Availability and rights remain with the linked providers. Use the viewing protocol in Appendix A: predict, observe, diagnose, qualify, and apply.

| Teaching moment | Link | Viewing question |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Selective attention / awareness test | [Awareness example 1](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Wie4v2YCPQY) · [Awareness example 2](https://youtu.be/vBPG_OBgTWg) | What remained visible but failed to become evidence? |
| Change blindness | [Change-blindness demonstration](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GOF-saZ1XSQ) | Which assumption of visual continuity made the change hard to notice? |
| Directed attention in *Focus* | [Attention scene](https://youtu.be/E26V363_k8o) | Which cues were deliberately made salient, and what did salience displace? |
| Opening mind trick | [Drawing / mind-trick example](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=43Mw-f6vIbo) | What fast interpretation appeared before inspection? |
| Confirmation “kiss test” | [Confirmation-bias example](https://youtu.be/Q3kfJu4y0M0) | Which observations were selected after the hypothesis was formed? |
| Mere exposure in *Focus* | [Familiarity scene](https://youtu.be/BuCMSuLGyJ4) | When does prior exposure become fluency, liking, or inferred truth? |
| Elevator conformity | [Elevator experiment](https://youtu.be/7Y0KT0ajZBw) | Is the behavior driven by information, belonging, or both? |
| Asch conformity | [Asch demonstration](https://youtu.be/TYIh4MkcfJA) | What changes when unanimity is broken? |
| Letting another person author the idea | [Kosta scene](https://youtu.be/sCtyg0n1no0) | How does autonomy change acceptance—and where could the method become manipulative? |
| Consistency | [Consistency example](https://youtu.be/pbdzMLk9wHQ) | Which earlier commitment changes the next action? |
| Vivid framing in debate | [“Horse-sized syringe” clip](https://youtu.be/H1JFGWBAC5c) | Which image or frame is likely to survive after the evidence is forgotten? |
| Recoverable story in *Borgen* | [Anna and her grandfather](https://youtu.be/ksH2zT7I6NM) | What causal chain allows another person to reconstruct the intended meaning? |
| Interests rather than positions | [Interests explainer](https://youtu.be/QCT1BWZByko) | Which question exposes the interest behind the stated demand? |
| Negotiation tactics in *30 Rock* | [Jack Donaghy scene](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hVbyetnjA44) | For each tactic, record reaction, hidden cost, and a better alternative. |
| Mutual improvement | [Win–win illustration](https://youtu.be/898OUCyBulM) | What changes when success is defined without requiring the other's failure? |
| Strategic silence | [Silence example](https://youtu.be/a7-eoiY4bOo) | When does silence create reflection, and when might it threaten safety or trust? |
| Tactics in *The Office* | [Michael Scott negotiation](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r-GFmH0EK9Y) | What was attempted, what information was lost, and what should replace it? |
| Lie-detection prediction | [Clinton clip](https://youtu.be/VBe_guezGGc) | Make a private prediction first; then ask whether demeanor was diagnostic. |
| Integrative negotiation in *Borgen* | [Negotiation scene](https://youtu.be/n--tLhsiMwA) | Identify positions, interests, leverage, trades, and value creation versus claiming. |
| Practical versus emotional conversation | [*It’s Not About the Nail*](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-4EDhdAHrOg) | Which conversation does each person believe they are having? |
| Reward prediction error | [Wolfram Schultz explanation](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pLqgakCXW5Q) | When does the signal move from outcome to predictive cue? |
| Intermittent reinforcement | [B. F. Skinner Foundation demonstration](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TtfQlkGwE2U) | What remains uncertain, and how does that uncertainty sustain responding? |
| B=MAP / behavior design | [BJ Fogg talk](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AdKUJxjn-R8) | Which component—motivation, ability, or prompt—is missing at the moment of action? |
| WOOP / mental contrasting | [Gabriele Oettingen explanation](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KH2SQb7crAY) | How does naming the internal obstacle change the plan? |
